_comment: Hand-written Bulgarian per food, keyed by USDA fdcId. This file is the ONLY source of
name_bg — a food without an entry here keeps its English name. It also overrides the
per-word search dictionary (bg-food-terms.json) for the head zone of search_text.
bg    → generic_foods.name_bg, the name shown in the UI
head  → the words naming what the food IS; goes in the head zone of search_text,
so typing them ranks this row as the food itself rather than a mention
terms → optional extra words worth finding it by (боб is also фасул, кисело мляко
is also йогурт). Omit when the head words are enough.
